Service

Wildlife Consulting

SOP and SWMS development, captive husbandry advice and specialist training for parks, zoos and government agencies.

Good wildlife-risk management starts on paper. Since 2002 our work has included collecting venomous snakes for the production of life-saving antivenom, rescuing and relocating thousands of snakes, and capturing and managing hundreds of crocodiles — and we worked with Parks Australia to develop, review and enhance SOPs and SWMS for Kakadu National Park personnel working with crocodiles.

What’s included

  • Standard operating procedures (SOPs) for wildlife handling and response
  • Safe work method statements (SWMS) for works in crocodile habitat
  • Wildlife risk assessments for projects, sites and events
  • Captive crocodile and reptile husbandry advice for parks and zoos
  • Specialist handler training for staff and agency teams
  • Expert advice for tenders, approvals and management plans

When you need it

Wildlife parks, zoos and sanctuaries

Government agencies and councils

Principal contractors writing project HSE documentation

Organisations reviewing procedures after an incident or near miss

Questions

Can you write SWMS for our project?

Yes. We prepare SWMS and risk assessments for works in and around crocodile and snake habitat, tailored to your site and methods.

Do you train zoo and park staff?

Yes. We provide specialist training and husbandry advice for teams that keep and handle crocodiles and reptiles.

Can you support a tender?

Yes. We can contribute wildlife-risk methodology and documentation to support your tender or approvals.
